title: Luscious Polish Fruit Pudding
description: A tangy and gooey Polish dessert featuring unflavored gelatin and flambe, perfect for a quick fix. This dish is a classic Polish treat that is both easy to make and delicious to eat.

ingredients.name: mixed fruit
ingredients.notes: such as strawberries, blueberries, and raspberries

instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle the gelatin over 1/4 cup of cold water and let it sit for 5 minutes to soften.
In a medium saucepan, combine the sugar, 1 3/4 cups of water, and mixed fruit, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes, or until the fruit is tender.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the softened gelatin and lemon juice until the gelatin is fully dissolved.
Let the mixture cool to room temperature, then cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours, or until chilled and set.
Just before serving, if using rum, warm it in a small saucepan over low heat, then ignite it and pour the flaming rum over the pudding.
Let the flames burn for 30 seconds to 1 minute, then blow them out and serve the pudding chilled.
Serve the pudding in individual cups or a large serving dish, garnished with additional mixed fruit if desired.
